$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file, typically "https://infinitus.run/schema/infinitus.json".

iconPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the project icon (e.g. "assets/logo.svg"). Checked before Infinitus's built-in icon locations.

defaultThreadEnvMode.description: Where new threads start for this repository: "worktree" for a fresh git worktree, "local" for the current checkout. A per-project setting in Infinitus overrides this; when neither is set, the global default applies.

name.description: Display name for the script, shown in the Infinitus scripts menu.

command.description: Shell command executed in a Infinitus terminal at the project root. The environment carries T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT, T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH (worktree threads) and T3CODE_PORT…T3CODE_PORT_END, ten ports derived from the checkout.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the script in the scripts menu. Defaults to "play".

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: When true, the script runs automatically after a worktree is created for a new thread.

previewUrl.description: URL opened in the in-app browser preview when this script runs. Only honored on the desktop build.

autoOpenPreview.description: When true, automatically open the preview panel at `previewUrl` the moment the script starts.

items.description: A project script that team members can import into Infinitus.

scripts.description: Project scripts shared with everyone who opens this repository in Infinitus.

title: Infinitus project file
description: Checked-in project configuration for Infinitus (infinitus.json at the repository root).
